name: ICE pair ranker
blurb: Paste the candidate lines from both sides of a call and see what ICE will do with them: which pairs it forms, which it drops as duplicates, and the order it tries them in, with each step explained.

inputs.label: Local candidates
inputs.description: One a=candidate line each, from your SDP or from webrtc-internals.
inputs.default:
a=candidate:1 1 udp 2130706431 192.168.1.42 50004 typ host
a=candidate:2 1 udp 1694498815 192.0.2.10 54321 typ srflx raddr 192.168.1.42 rport 50004
a=candidate:3 1 udp 16777215 198.51.100.50 49152 typ relay raddr 192.0.2.10 rport 54321

inputs.label: Remote candidates
inputs.description: The other side's, the same way.

inputs.label: Controlling side
inputs.description: The agent that nominates the pair. Its candidates are G in the pair formula, the other side's D.
